issue_context.title: Wrong count of issues in labels
issue_context.body:
Gitea ver: gitea.com

Labels page showing sometime wrong open issues count.

![label](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1280585/65110914-74b7e580-d9f3-11e9-873a-ed752833148b.png)

Ref #8190
comments:
Hi @lunny seems Gitea.com is on more latest commit which should have this fix already.

But unfortunately it is still showing wrong count. Maybe it is related to PRs count in labels?

Check here
https://gitea.com/mmarif/GitNex/labels

> 
> 
> Hi @lunny seems Gitea.com is on more latest commit which should have this fix already.
> 
> But unfortunately it is still showing wrong count. Maybe it is related to PRs count in labels?
> 
> Check here
> https://gitea.com/mmarif/GitNex/labels

The counts will be fixed only after someone adds/removes an issue from the milestone.

> 
> 
> Hi @lunny seems Gitea.com is on more latest commit which should have this fix already.
> 
> But unfortunately it is still showing wrong count. Maybe it is related to PRs count in labels?
> 
> Check here
> https://gitea.com/mmarif/GitNex/labels

The counts will be fixed only after someone adds/removes an issue from the milestone.

@lunny Perhaps it's worth a migration step for 1.10.0 to "normalize" the database?
@guillep2k yeah, a migration will fix all the wrong counting. Good idea!
